resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We study recombination-sensitive branch structure on a fixed-support substrate in Six Birds Theory. Building on prior work on event packaging and predictive holonomy, we introduce branch assemblages and two quotient levels at an interface: a branchwise predictive quotient ( K_i ), which captures independent predictive treatment of the branches, and a recombination quotient ( R_i ), which captures admissible recombination observables on branch families. On this architecture we exhibit a benchmark suite separating classical mixture, hidden predictive memory without recombination sensitivity, route-marked suppression, erasure-conditioned recovery, cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. A supporting theorem layer proves the abstract factorized no-interference regime and its obstruction by strict refinement, and one promoted positive family is connected to a theorem-backed concrete witness in an aligned Lean model. We do not claim a general reconstruction of non-Hilbert interference or a formalization of the full benchmark runtime. The claim is narrower: these recombination phenomena arise on fixed support, can be audited exactly, and admit a partial formal backbone on the Six Birds substrate.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We introduce a fixed-support route-transport framework in which histories can be equivalent at a current event interface yet differ as predictors of later admissible observations. For each interface, we define a current quotient by present-event indistinguishability and a predictive quotient by equality of all later admissible event statistics under continuation. Standard quotient-algebraic results then apply in this setting: future-predictive equivalence refines current-event equivalence, admissible continuations induce well-defined transport on , and the current class after transport is determined by the source predictive class through a canonical mixed map _i _j . Generic transport on along all outgoing continuations exists precisely at flat interfaces, where current equivalence already determines all future observations. The predictive quotient is future-sufficient, and every future-sufficient state abstraction factors uniquely through on the reachable image. Strict refinement of is equivalent to existence of a pair of histories that are current-equivalent but future-distinct. For endo-continuations, representative push can preserve the current class of every history while moving a predictive class. The contribution of the paper is the framework itself and the demonstration that it is non-vacuous: an axiom-audited finite memory-wheel instance in Lean and exact finite fixed-support benchmarks instantiate strict refinement and the loop asymmetry, while the computational suite separates artifact, flattenable, explicit-latent, dissipative, and coherent-candidate regimes with bounded robustness under perturbation. Small discovery searches recover additional coherent candidates beyond the hand-built examples while a control search space remains all-flat.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: When must an operator-valued obstruction associated with an involutive system vanish? This paper answers that question inside the Six Birds framework by naming Self-Dual Trace Confinement (SDTC) as the recognition source for formed closures with genuine involutive self-duality. The mechanism is the duality-confinement membrane theorem: for an involutive object ledger with separating anti-invariant readout, a sequence of positive domination records B_n with B_n 0 forces the anti-invariant ledger to vanish and confines visible mass to the fixed locus of the duality. The supporting apparatus develops the involutive object ledger, the anti-invariant ledger and trace identity, direct qualitative and quantitative confinement, completed-domination bridges, Douglas factorization in typed-cone form, exhaustive moving ledgers, and optimized scalar trace budgets. Operator-theoretic realization over trace-class operators is an open extension, as is a derivation of the AM–GM step inside a typed real-arithmetic structure. The development is formalized in Lean as a mathlib-free mechanization at the typed positive-cone level (Appendix ). Cross-substrate generalizations such as CPT symmetry, gauge invariance, quantum self-adjointness, and function-field RH are presented as structural predictions, not theorems; the paper develops the abstract apparatus layer and names the hypotheses any substrate-specific application must supply.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The contested program. The most anticipated near-term probe of quantum gravity is the BMV proposal (Bose et al.; Marletto–Vedral) : place two masses in spatial superpositions, let only gravity couple them, and test whether they become entangled. The widely-stated inference is that gravitationally-induced entanglement would witness a quantum (coherent) gravitational mediator — a graviton-like degree of freedom. The fork of §5.2 forces the opposite: the gravitational arm is a sibling readout that does not have access to the quantum phase mode and cannot carry it coherently between parties.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The abstract route-transport package consists of a fixed support object, a family of interfaces, interface-indexed history sets, typed continuation sets, interface-indexed event sets, and the operations of identity continuation, continuation composition, representative push, and current observation, subject to identity and composition laws for push. The two fundamental equivalence relations are current-event equivalence and future-predictive equivalence. Their quotients define the current quotient Q and the predictive quotient M , with canonical comparison map pi : M → Q induced by refinement. The finite implementation of Section should be read as an exact model of this abstract package rather than as a separate semantics. In particular, the benchmark and discovery sections do not change the theorem layer; they instantiate it.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Beyond the scope boundaries stated in Section , two further limitations deserve mention. The Lean formalization is intentionally partial: it covers the quotient comparison, predictive and mixed transport, the flatness characterization, sufficiency on the reachable image, witness/strict-refinement equivalence, representative-level loop asymmetry, and a finite non-vacuity instance, but does not yet formalize moved-class sets, cardinality-based nontriviality criteria, or richer action-level invariants. Those omissions do not undermine the present results, but they mark the current boundary of the formal development. The benchmark and discovery labels should also be read operationally rather than ontologically. In particular, coherent_candidate denotes a benchmark or discovered candidate that exhibits the loop asymmetry and witness structure targeted by the paper. It is not a claim that a stronger external state representation has been forced.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The paper establishes a substrate-level result. On a fixed-support Six Birds architecture, branchwise predictive structure and recombination-sensitive structure can be separated operationally, and that separation can be audited under exact finite controls. The benchmark suite shows that the same substrate supports a classical-mixture null regime, hidden predictive memory without additional recombination sensitivity, readable-route suppression, erased conditional recovery, bounded cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. The formal contribution is narrower. The Lean development proves an abstract refinement layer under detectability, a factorized no-interference regime in which the recombination quotient collapses to the branchwise quotient, and the corresponding obstruction result that strict refinement rules out global branchwise factorization. It also proves one theorem-backed concrete positive instance for an aligned Lean model of the promoted family n5_d1_w1of4_3of4 . These results support the interpretation of the benchmark suite but do not replace it.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The program's open problems are not vague: each is a named lemma or audit with a stated success criterion. (i) The L60 → L64 lemma — mass-closure charge-linking forbids a second neutral record channel — upgrades Prediction 3 to an all-structures law. (ii) The F43 continuum audit — tower-coherence, cofinality, residual-vanishing, completion — either licenses the continuum Einstein limit of the discrete consistency condition or names the exact obstruction. (iii) Exact RT saturation in the large-bond limit (the 0.729→0.904→0.941 trend made a theorem with a rate). (iv) Uniqueness of the grounding: whether semiclassical co-sourcing is the only admissible warrant for the common carrier (warranted → forced). (v) A third substrate for the universality thesis — the atlas's remaining foreclosure edges (black-hole thermodynamics and singularities are the natural candidates) — turning n=2 into n=3 with the genre-expectation again stated in advance.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The first extension target is an operator-theoretic realization of the typed cone. One would instantiate the cone with positive trace-class operators on a Hilbert space, prove the trace identity and positivity-to-zero inside that setting, and connect the Douglas factorization carrier used here to the usual range inclusion theorem for bounded Hilbert-space operators. The second extension target is scalar arithmetic. The optimized trace budget currently tracks the AM–GM step through a typed-scalar hypothesis. A stronger treatment would introduce enough typed real-arithmetic structure to express ( a - b )^2≥0 and derive AM–GM internally rather than using it as a supplied scalar fact.
